domain: Equipment Rental, Fleet Operations & Billing Analytics
business_context: Legacy processes relied on full-refresh load patterns and monolithic transformation chains that caused severe compute overhead, long daily batch runtimes, and costly rerun efforts upon failure.
summary_angle: Data Engineer specializing in high-volume telemetry ingestion and streaming lakehouse pipelines on AWS and Databricks

phase_1_ingestion.daily_activity: Extracting high-volume operational records from legacy/on-prem sources and streaming real-time IoT equipment telemetry payloads.
swappable_categories: Ingestion Tools (Kafka, Fivetran, Event Hubs, Debezium)

phase_2_storage.daily_activity: Landing high-throughput raw operational and telemetry datasets into structured cloud storage layers.
swappable_categories: Cloud Storage (Azure ADLS, Google Cloud Storage, MinIO)

phase_3_transformation.daily_activity: Building PySpark and Spark SQL pipelines to clean, normalize, and process CDC incremental updates while decoupling monolithic transformation chains into modular, restartable stages.
key_optimizations: Replaced full-refresh cycles with scheduled incremental load patterns
Tuned partition strategies and optimized Spark SQL joins
Decoupled pipelines into modular checkpointed stages
swappable_categories: Transformation & Modeling (dbt, Apache Flink, Snowflake SQL, BigQuery)

phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.daily_activity: Managing pipeline dependencies with retry policies, enforcing schema validation, and structuring dimensional star schemas and materialized tables in Teradata.

phase_5_serving_and_bi.phase_name: Semantic Layers & BI Serving (SUPPRESS IF ROLE IS PURE BACKEND DE)
phase_5_serving_and_bi.daily_activity: Building optimized SQL semantic reporting layers and interactive dashboards to deliver operational and fleet metrics to business leadership.

metrics_and_impact.rerun_reduction: Decreased pipeline rerun effort by 30–40% through modular stage design
metrics_and_impact.runtime_reduction: Reduced daily batch runtimes by 25–30% via PySpark partition tuning and Spark SQL join optimization
metrics_and_impact.reliability: Ensured 0% data loss across multi-terabyte datasets spanning rental, inventory, and billing operations
